name: ossrank
description: Static-first public ranking site for observed open-source contributors, projects, and ecosystem momentum.

scripts.build: tsx scripts/build-site.ts --data data/latest --history data/history --out dist && pnpm run build:cli
scripts.test: pnpm run test:unit && pnpm run test:burst && pnpm run check && pnpm run refresh:fixtures && pnpm run validate:data && pnpm run build && pnpm run smoke:cli
scripts.dev: pnpm run build && npx --yes serve dist
scripts.deploy:cloudflare: pnpm run build && wrangler pages deploy dist --project-name ossrank
scripts.smoke:cli: pnpm run build:cli && node dist-cli/cli.js rank contributors --input fixtures/contributors.json --limit 2 --format table && node dist-cli/cli.js token-check --token demo && ! node dist-cli/cli.js rank contributors --input fixtures/contributors.json --limit nope

author: Roger Chappel
